acceptanceCriteria: Execute and qualify Go go test, Rust Cargo and nextest including doctests, .NET xUnit/NUnit/MSTest on VSTest and Microsoft.Testing.Platform, and C/C++ CTest/GoogleTest/Catch2 under exact tool/runtime profiles.

Actual test identity, ignored/skipped/retried/no-tests and build/collection/infrastructure outcomes are retained; no stable Cargo JSON or .NET MTP support is inferred from a different runtime profile.
Immutable inputs and fixed invocations integrate shared receipts with CEM/Tasks; actual runtime qualification, cleanup and independent review remain required for every row.
body: Owner-authorized parallel child of V1-0591. Owner scope amendment 2026-10-01: "I want to get CEM to v1.0 for the main v1.0 release"; "we are supposted to be supporting all the main test runners for all the languages we support"; "work on all these in parallell". Usage credits explicitly authorized. This is the release target and execution-coverage requirement, not a promotion receipt. Existing research V1-0573 and prototype V1-0575 remain open with their original evidence obligations. Current public source has eight affected-language adapters and sixteen candidate analyzer families; runner execution and test discovery must be audited separately. Main-runner inventory must include every existing registered runner plus primary frameworks for each supported language; candidate/domain ambiguity needs explicit retained disposition rather than silent omission. Parallel lanes dynamic, native and platform use one shared experimental runner contract and one Tasks boundary lane; no default queue cutover or wire relabeling. Release promotion and merge authority remain separate.
title: CEM 1.0 runners: Go, Rust, .NET and C/C++
